topology.rationale: Canonical pair and member ordering, standard pair identity, scenario resolution, and malformed-topology rejection satisfy the frozen topology contract.

capture.rationale: Neutral capture, contested freeze, friendly repair, two-stage takeover, exact timing, and damage neutralization match the approved state machine.

alignment.rationale: Alignment remains derived and reversible with deterministic begin and break ordering, no duplicate events, and no persisted activation state.

gameplay-consequence.rationale: Command remains per Node, Dominance is exactly pair-only at two per second, and the existing Bastion and time-cap outcomes remain authoritative.

ai.rationale: Scout completion and denial priorities, main-force bonuses, visible-threat defense, stable tie-breaks, and timed Bastion commitment satisfy both factions deterministically.

persistence.rationale: World v2 pair persistence, strict runtime scenario v2, deterministic v1 migration, partial-state continuation, and legacy envelope compatibility all pass.

presentation.rationale: HUD summary and Node details, visibility-safe mate state, minimap indices and outlines, ARIA text, alerts, desktop Low, and narrow containment are ship-ready.

regression.rationale: Focused tests, full lint and build checks, 438 unit tests, and the fresh veteran-mirror core-match cohort pass against the same source snapshot.

scope.rationale: No chord bonus, overhead intelligence, transport, stabilization, alternate victory, strategic annulus, shadow expansion, or campaign-finale behavior was introduced.

polish.summary: At the 1280x720 desktop target, the compact ALIGN label and value may wrap onto separate lines while remaining legible and correctly announced.
polish.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if milestone HUD qualification finds the wrapping obscures another resource or reduces the Alignment task below ship-ready.
